title: BigPizzaV3/CodexPlusPlus
claim: BigPizzaV3/CodexPlusPlus — An enhanced tool for CodexApp, striving to make Codex better to use and more comfortable 一个CodexApp的增强工具，努力让Codex变得更好用更舒
why_good: An enhancement layer for CodexApp — fixes real usability gaps, but it's an add-on wholly dependent on someone else's app.
value: Thin monetization at best (pro add-on); no leverage if Codex itself adopts the improvements.
risk: Feature, not a company: if CodexApp absorbs these tweaks, it's obsolete overnight.

zh.claim: BigPizzaV3/CodexPlusPlus —— CodexApp 的增强工具,让 Codex 更好用、更顺手。
zh.why_good: 给 CodexApp 的增强层——补了真实的易用性缺口,但它是完全依附别人 app 的插件。
zh.value: 顶多做薄变现(专业版插件);一旦 Codex 自己采纳这些改进就没了杠杆。
zh.risk: 是功能不是公司:CodexApp 把这些改动吸收进去,它一夜过时。
zh.hook: 让 CodexApp 更好用——方便,但是个 Codex 一夜就能吸收的插件。

hook: Makes CodexApp nicer to use — handy, but an add-on Codex itself could absorb overnight.
